description: This file implements a FAPI-to-PHY fast path translator for 5G NR, handling downlink and uplink message translation, validation, and processing, including resource grid management, PDU translation, and controller coordination.

classes.name: error_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of error_indication_notifier used as placeholder.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator
classes.description: Main class implementing the translation and processing of FAPI messages to PHY PDUs.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::slot_based_upper_phy_controller
classes.description: Controller managing downlink processing for a specific slot.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::slot_based_upper_phy_controller_manager
classes.description: Manager handling controller instances for multiple slots.

classes.name: downlink_pdus
classes.description: Helper struct storing downlink PHY PDUs for a slot.

classes.name: uplink_pdus
classes.description: Helper struct storing uplink PHY PDUs for a slot.

methods.name: translate_dl_tti_pdus_to_phy_pdus
methods.description: Translates and validates DL PDUs from FAPI to PHY format, dropping entire message on validation failure.

methods.name: translate_ul_tti_pdus_to_phy_pdus
methods.description: Translates and validates UL PDUs from FAPI to PHY format, dropping entire message on validation failure.

methods.name: send_dl_tti_request
methods.description: Processes a DL TTI request message, translating PDUs, managing controllers, and handling errors.

methods.name: send_ul_tti_request
methods.description: Processes an UL TTI request message, translating PDUs, managing controllers, and handling errors.

methods.name: send_ul_dci_request
methods.description: Processes an UL DCI request message, translating and validating PDUs, and managing controllers.

methods.name: send_tx_data_request
methods.description: Processes a TX Data request, validating, matching, and forwarding PDUs, with error handling.

methods.name: on_last_message
methods.description: Releases the controller for a given slot.

methods.name: handle_new_slot
methods.description: Updates current slot context and logger for a new slot.

methods.name: is_message_in_time
methods.description: Checks if a message's slot is within the acceptable time window relative to current slot.

methods.name: get_re_pattern_port
methods.description: Constructs a RE pattern for a given CSI-RS port.

methods.name: generate_csi_re_pattern_list
methods.description: Generates a list of RE patterns for CSI-RS PDUs in a DL TTI request.

methods.name: get_prach_dectector_config_from
methods.description: Creates a PRACH detector configuration from a buffer context.
